attacks.name: Staff of the Living Tribunal
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Push|: If the defender is |!size| 2 or less, before |!damage| is dealt, this character may Push it Away |!range_small|.

attacks.name: Bolts of Bishru
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!wild| |*Hex|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§hex§Hex| special condition.

attacks.name: Rains of Raggadorr
steps: |*Burning Rain|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§incinerate§Incinerate| and |§poison§Poison| special conditions.

superPowers.name: Master of the Occult
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character gains 2 |!power|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Soul Barb
superPowers.body: Choose an enemy character within |!range| 3 of this character with 1 or more of the following special conditions: |§hex§Hex|, |§incinerate§Incinerate|, |§poison§Poison|, or |§slow§Slow|. Choose 1 of these special conditions on that character. Each enemy character within |!range| 2 of the chosen character gains the chosen special condition.

superPowers.name: Ferocity of Cyttorak
superPowers.body: When another allied character within |!range| 3 of this character makes an attack, during the |*Create Attack Dice Pool| step, this character may use this superpower. The attacking character adds 2 dice to its attack roll. After the attack is resolved, the attacker suffers 1 |!damage|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Vaulting Boots of Valtorr
superPowers.body: When this character is Pushed, after the effect is resolved, it may use this superpower. This character Advances |!range_small|.
